summary: HQ Floor 7: Badge deactivation, hotdesk provisioning, and equipment return coordination
description:
Issue summary: Employee offboarding/desk change requiring badge deactivation, provisioning of two hotdesks on 7th floor for interim contractors, and coordination to collect/ship a laptop and monitor back to IT stock. Impact: access needs to be restricted for offboarded user and new hotdesk access created same-day; equipment must be returned to inventory to avoid asset loss.

Details:
- Offboarded user: Marcus Chen (left 2026-03-09)
- Desk to be vacated: 7F-Desk-12 (hotdesk)
- Equipment pickup: MacBook Pro serial S/N MP0Y12345, Dell 24\" monitor S/N DL56789
- Destination for returned equipment: IT Returns Locker #3 (Mailroom West Wing)
- Required actions: badge deactivation for Marcus, badge provisioning for contractors (two temporary badges), schedule mailroom pickup and confirm shipping label/manifest, update asset inventory and return-to-stock.

Desired outcome: Marcus's badge disabled by end of business day 2026-03-10; two contractor temporary badges issued with hotdesk access to 7th floor; hardware picked up from 7F and delivered to IT Returns Locker with tracking number; inventory record updated and ticket closed.
steps_to_resolve: Facilities: verify Marcus Chen badge ID (badge 41287) and disable access in Paxton system; set badge to revoked and add note 'offboarded 2026-03-09'
IT-Support: create two temporary badges in access-control with expiration 2026-04-09 and scope '7th floor hotdesks'
Mailroom: schedule same-day pickup from 7F Hotdesk Area at 16:00 and move items to IT Returns Locker #3; print return manifest and affix shipping label if outbound shipment needed
Shipping: if Monitor/MacBook are to be sent to Seattle warehouse, generate UPS label (account Redwood-OPS-02) and obtain tracking number; otherwise mark as local stock in inventory system
Inventory: log S/N MP0Y12345 and DL56789 as 'received' and update asset owner to 'IT Inventory', change status to 'inspected' after QA check
Requester follow-up: confirm contractor badge recipients and provide IDs for badge pickup at Facilities desk
comments: Jordan Miller (Facilities) - 2026-03-10: Reported Marcus Chen left on 2026-03-09. Confirming desk cleared and equipment located at 7F-Desk-12. Marcus badge ID: 41287. Requesting badge disable and two temporary badges for contractors starting 2026-03-11.
Priya Desai (IT) - 2026-03-10: Assigned. Will queue badge disable in Paxton and provision temporary badges. Need contractor names and government ID photos for provisioning — tagging PeopleOps.
Riley Santos (PeopleOps) - 2026-03-10: Provided contractor names: Aisha Patel and Tom Nguyen. IDs attached in PeopleOps folder (internal link: https://confluence.redwood/peopleops/contractor-ids).

Mailroom Bot (Automated) - 2026-03-10: Pickup scheduled at 2026-03-10 16:00. Courier: internal facilities-runner. Initial pickup completed at 2026-03-10 16:12 by Mateo R. Items moved to IT Returns Locker #3.

Priya Desai (IT) - 2026-03-11: Inspected items: MacBook Pro S/N MP0Y12345 has minor scuff on lid, battery health 92%; Dell monitor S/N DL56789 powers on, no dead pixels. Marked both as 'received' in Inventory (inventory ticket INV-2147). Preparing UPS label for transfer to Seattle warehouse per inventory policy.
Logistics (Shipping) - 2026-03-11: UPS label generated - Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784. Shipment scheduled 2026-03-12 morning pickup. Updating ticket with tracking and manifest.
resolution_notes: Badge 41287 disabled by Facilities on 2026-03-10; two temporary badges issued to Aisha Patel and Tom Nguyen (expire 2026-04-09). Mailroom pickup completed and items transferred to IT Returns Locker #3, inspected and logged under INV-2147. UPS shipment created (1Z999AA10123456784) and booked for 2026-03-12. Follow-up: confirm receipt at Seattle warehouse and close ticket after inventory reconciles.
